text:
ivy (eng-platform): quick sync: building a tiny "Cost Clarity" mini-panel for the dashboard. single-line summary + 'explain' link that opens a modal with CSV download. aim: reduce support tickets. suggestions?

omar (billing): include a stable CSV schema. auditors want date, tenant_id, route_id, sku, token_burn, tokens_saved_est, dollars_est, allocation_method, correction_factor. make header names final before beta.

lena (product): make the one-liner non-monetary by default: 'effective tokens' + small reason pill if routing changed. let finance toggle dollars.

sam (eng-ml): on sampling: surface sample_rate and a confidence tag. propose confidence levels: high (>50%), medium (10-50%), low (<10%). show a tiny amber dot for medium, red for low.

tri (design): UI: one-line format: "Tokens • Cache est. (pct) • SKU • reason" and an 'Explain' chevron. In modal show three rows: tokens, cache (est), routing delta + small formula link. include microcopy "Estimated from sample" where needed.

ivy (eng-platform): API plan: /v1/costs/explain?route=<id>&date=YYYY-MM-DD returns a compact row and a csv link. we'll precompute nightly and add a derived_from_sample boolean.

omar (billing): require billing role for tenant-level CSVs; devs can download route-level CSVs. also store pricing_snapshot_id in rows used for dollars_est.

lena (product): timeline: mock end of week, beta with billing next week. please add test tenants to the RFC so finance can validate.

deploy-bot: job queued -> cost-clarity-precompute v0.1 -> staging. initiated by @ivy. :rocket:
